Who makes or sells the computing AI runs on: chips, servers, AI clouds and the large clouds. Meta builds data centers for its own use and is left to the AI list. SpaceX was proposed by the research and left out as a side line.

reason.en: Nvidia sells the GPUs and networking that AI data centers are built on
reason.pt: a Nvidia vende as GPUs e os equipamentos de rede que formam os data centers de IA

reason.en: Microsoft's Azure sells computing for AI workloads from its own data centers
reason.pt: a Azure, da Microsoft, vende computação para cargas de IA a partir de data centers próprios

reason.en: Amazon's AWS sells on-demand computing, storage and AI services
reason.pt: a AWS, da Amazon, vende computação sob demanda, armazenamento e serviços de IA

reason.en: Google Cloud sells AI infrastructure, including Alphabet's own TPU chips
